scope: OFFLINE Task2 source review only; no Julia or runtime acceptance

findings.title: Guard scalar probe argument reads
findings.detail: The two _upper_value arguments are eagerly evaluated even for probe=nothing. Each performs searchsortedfirst; the source route adds two packed searches per ordinary scalar pivot. Compiler removal is unproven and must not be presumed. Put the observation, including its argument reads, under probe!==nothing. Preserve the original pivot comparison and suffix inverse; update fault clone/source map.

findings.title: Avoid duplicated full pure-run lookahead
findings.detail: The outer _last_pure_bartels_golub_swap scans the run then scalar_suffix scans it again. A length-L run adds O(sum(log(length(column.indices)+1))) packed-search work, worst O(n log n), solely to select the scalar route. Current zero diagonal already requires scalar fallback. Dispatch using the exact current-diagonal zero predicate and leave unrestricted pure-run search to the original suffix. No tolerance, numerical policy or frozen Task1 change is needed. Account for the remaining one packed diagonal lookup at each blocked boundary.

findings.title: Choose final packed column through column_order
findings.detail: The no-elimination test requests original basis column96. _prepare_spike! maps this through factor.positions, and DIRECT export retains a backend column permutation, so this does not establish that r==n. Select j=f.inner.column_order[end], use B[:,j], and replace at j; assert its current position is final. This makes the no-op lifecycle gate independent of backend ordering.

findings.title: Correct source budget and lifecycle entry counts
findings.detail: 72*96+16*cld(9*96,64)+4352 is11488, not11480. Lifecycle has five successful FTRAN entries per backend: two prepared RHS, one new entering column, and two original-B residual solves. The separately listed busy FTRAN is a sixth attempt, not two additional successful entries. Reconcile counts again after the extra failure case and boundary fix; lookahead O(n) omitted its packed binary searches.

findings.title: Exercise exception cleanup after a committed panel
findings.detail: All three fault injections occur in the first panel. The late explicit-zero case is successful scalar fallback. The accepted Task1 handoff specifically requires Task2 failure after earlier committed panels: add a cold case that arms a fault at the second panel boundary and proves one prior commit, exact exception identity, no finish/final update publication, dropped workspace, reset busy, invalid prepared/prefix/incidence state. Do not require rollback; update visible constructor/elimination/fault budgets.
